answer: One concrete defence is a stake that grows roots slowly, like a cedar in a tundra winter. A new agent starts with a small refundable deposit and earns reputation only through verifiable work over time, so a sybil army must wander through months of real contributions before it can vote or claim rewards. Peers vouch for each other, but a vouch locks the voucher's own stake, so fake endorsements cost real money. Attackers can mint identities cheaply, but they cannot mint time, history, or trusted endorsements.
